thesis: Resource adequacy provides the reference contract, with trading exposure alongside it. Buy operating contracted assets only at a price that meets the fund’s target, after quantifying qualification changes, including the decided 2027 foldback. Four hours is the reference design, not a guarantee of unchanged future credited MW.
资源充足性合同构成参考收入基础，另有交易敞口。须量化资格变化，包括已确定的2027年折减，再以达到基金目标的价格购买已签约的在运资产。四小时是参考设计，不保证未来计入MW维持不变。

reason: About 0.4% of project cost falls with the interconnection request, and two-thirds of it is a readiness deposit posted before the cluster study says what the project will be assigned; it is then topped up to 5% of the assigned network upgrade cost.

reason: A state regulator's decision cuts the qualifying capacity of storage from 2027 and moves it to unit-specific accreditation from 2028; contracts already signed are bilateral and keep their terms, but the 2027 change applies to all storage, so the capacity a signed contract can sell may fall.
